comment: VortexPanel software builds and VortexPanel's own Apps. base_url: public address of the software R2 bucket (custom domain). mirrors: GitHub Releases copies of the software, used when base_url fails or when chosen in Software updates > Download source. apps_url: public address of the separate R2 bucket that holds VortexPanel's own Apps (index.json + packages); the Apps are never on GitHub. keys: Ed25519 public keys allowed to sign catalog.json and the App index. While base_url or keys is empty, the App Store installs from the OS package sources.
